description: A demo scholarship that supports school and undergraduate students from low and middle income families with tuition and learning material costs.
benefits: One-time scholarship amount of ₹50,000 credited directly to the student's bank account each academic year.

additionalRequirements: Must be enrolled full-time in a recognised school or college
Must not be receiving any other central government scholarship

ministry: Demo Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
description: A demo income-support scheme for small and marginal farmers that own cultivable land, aimed at covering seed, fertiliser, and irrigation costs.
benefits: Direct benefit transfer of ₹60,000 per year, paid in two equal instalments.

additionalRequirements: Must own or cultivate agricultural land in the applicant's name or family's name
Land ownership documents must be submitted at the time of application

ministry: Demo Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: A demo scheme offering seed capital and mentorship to women who want to start or grow a small business.
benefits: Collateral-free loan of up to ₹5,00,000 at a subsidised interest rate, plus a one-time mentorship grant of ₹25,000.

additionalRequirements: Applicant must be the primary owner of the proposed business
Business plan document must be submitted

ministry: Demo Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: A demo monthly pension scheme for senior citizens without a stable source of retirement income.
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹2,000 credited directly to the beneficiary's bank account.

additionalRequirements: Must not already be receiving a government pension of an equal or higher amount

ministry: Demo Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
description: A demo scheme that provides free vocational training and placement assistance to unemployed youth.
benefits: Free 3-month skill training, a stipend of ₹3,000 per month during training, and placement support.

additionalRequirements: Must not be currently employed full-time

ministry: Demo Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: A demo scheme that provides financial assistance to low-income rural households for building or repairing a house.
benefits: One-time housing assistance of ₹1,20,000 released in three construction-linked instalments.

additionalRequirements: Household must not already own a pucca house
Applicant must own or have clear rights over the plot of land for construction

ministry: Demo Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: A demo health insurance scheme offering cashless hospitalisation cover for economically vulnerable families.
benefits: Cashless health cover of up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year at empanelled hospitals.

additionalRequirements: Family must not already be covered under another government health insurance scheme

ministry: Demo Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
description: A demo scheme offering low-interest loans and mentoring to help small business owners scale their operations.
benefits: Business loan of up to ₹10,00,000 at a subsidised interest rate with a partial credit guarantee.

additionalRequirements: Business must be registered as a micro or small enterprise
Applicant must not have defaulted on a previous government-backed loan

description: A demo fellowship supporting postgraduate and doctoral students pursuing research at recognised institutions.
benefits: Monthly fellowship stipend of ₹35,000 plus an annual contingency grant of ₹50,000 for research expenses.

additionalRequirements: Must be enrolled in a full-time postgraduate or doctoral research programme
Must not be receiving another central fellowship for the same programme

description: A demo livelihood scheme that provides guaranteed work days and skill-linked wages to rural households.
benefits: Guaranteed 100 days of paid work per year at a daily wage of ₹350, plus access to skill-linked livelihood projects.

additionalRequirements: Applicant's household must reside in a designated rural area
Applicant must be willing to undertake manual or skilled labour under the scheme
